title: Most news apps are built to keep you scrolling until you are exhausted.
body:
That is the default model for the internet. It relies on outrage, endless notifications, and the assumption that your attention is a resource to be mined. We wanted to build something different.

At Headlinne, our philosophy is simple. We believe news should be helpful, not overwhelming. We use AI not to feed you more content, but to filter out the noise. The goal is to give you exactly what you need to understand the world, and then let you get on with your day.

True intelligence in a news app means respecting your time. It means surfacing the facts without the fluff. It means removing the incentives to click and replacing them with the incentives to learn. A smarter news experience isn't about knowing everything. It is about knowing what matters to you.
cta: If you are tired of the noise, you can see how we are rethinking the daily news feed at HEADLINNE.com.
